dedupe_keys.name: point cloud suction head location in site b

description: TU Delft provides suction-head position observations from induced flowslide experiments at Site-B. A GPS device installed on the suction head monitored the dredger while it undercut the submerged slope toe. The source identifies the experiment in Chapter 6.4 of the associated sand-slope thesis. Coverage: The test-site location is unstated.; 28 and 29/5/2019. Format: bin. Access: public native descriptive metadata. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. Current file access and cost remain unknown. Caveats: The binary descriptor does not establish a standard point-cloud format. Coordinate reference system, positioning accuracy and sampling interval are unstated. The source-defined parent collection concerns breaching flowslides during mining activities. Simulation use is interpreted as mining slope-hazard and geotechnical calibration evidence; no independent model validation is asserted. Related resources in the native collection have separate identities.
